property_summary: After XBornID() is called, the caller's blacklist entry remains false.
After calling XBornID(), a non-owner caller's blacklist entry remains false if the caller was not previously blacklisted.
After calling XBornID(), the caller's blacklist entry is unchanged (false) for any non-owner caller.
After XBornID() is called by any address, the blacklist entry for any address other than the caller remains unchanged.
After a call to XBornID(), the caller's blacklist entry is false, because only the original owner can call XBornID() and XBornID() does not modify blacklist.
After calling XBornID(), the blacklist status of any address that called getTokens should be true if toGive > 0.
After calling XBornID(), totalSupply minus totalDistributed equals totalSupply minus totalDistributed from before the call.
After calling XBornID(), the totalSupply should be equal to the original totalSupply minus the amount burned, but not increased.

After calling XBornID(), the sum of balances of all addresses that have been transferred to plus the contract's own balance should be at least as large as before the call, and totalSupply should never increase.
After a call to XBornID(), the totalSupply should never increase (i.e., it stays the same or decreases).
After calling XBornID(), totalSupply remains unchanged.
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed equals the value set by the constructor (200000000e18) regardless of any prior distribution calls.
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed remains unchanged from its initial value (200000000e18) regardless of any prior calls to getTokens() or distr().
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed is at least 200000000e18 regardless of any prior getTokens() calls.
After calling XBornID(), the sum of totalDistributed and totalRemaining always equals totalSupply (500000000e18).
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed is exactly the initial totalDistributed value (200000000e18), regardless of any previous distribution calls.
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed equals the initial totalDistributed plus the amount transferred in the call.
For any user, after calling XBornID(), the contract's totalRemaining equals totalSupply minus totalDistributed.
After calling XBornID from a non-owner user, the value of totalRemaining should remain unchanged.
After calling XBornID() via a non-owner, totalRemaining stays unchanged because it is not decreased.
After any call to XBornID(), the sum of totalDistributed and totalRemaining must equal totalSupply.
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed equals the value set in XBornID() regardless of any previous burn calls.
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed equals the initial totalDistributed plus the amount distributed, which is always less than or equal to totalSupply.
After XBornID(), totalDistributed >= 200000000 ether and totalDistributed <= totalSupply.
After XBornID(), totalRemaining equals totalSupply minus totalDistributed.
After calling XBornID(), totalRemaining and totalDistributed sum to totalSupply.
After calling XBornID(), totalRemaining is strictly less than initial totalRemaining.
After XBornID() is called, totalDistributed should equal the sum of initial totalDistributed and any amounts passed to distr.
After calling XBornID(), the totalDistributed state variable must be greater than or equal to the initial totalDistributed.
When distr is called from getTokens, the totalDistributed increases by exactly the amount transferred.
After calling XBornID(), the totalDistributed state variable is equal to its initial value plus any amounts distributed through distr calls.
After calling XBornID(), the public state variable totalDistributed must be at least 200000000e18 (the initial value set in the constructor).
After calling XBornID(), totalRemaining must equal the original totalRemaining minus the amount added to totalDistributed.
After any sequence of public calls ending with XBornID(), the sum of totalDistributed and totalRemaining must equal totalSupply.
The state variable totalRemaining should equal totalSupply minus totalDistributed after any sequence of public calls including XBornID().
After calling XBornID(), the sum of totalDistributed and totalRemaining equals totalSupply.
After calling XBornID(), totalRemaining equals totalSupply minus totalDistributed.
After calling XBornID(), the value of totalRemaining must be exactly 300000000e18 (the initial totalRemaining before distribution).
After calling XBornID(), totalDistributed equals the initial totalDistributed (200000000e18).
After calling XBornID(), totalRemaining should equal totalSupply - totalDistributed.
After a call to XBornID(), the public variable `value` must be smaller than its original value set in the constructor (1000e18) because it gets halved each time.

After calling XBornID() followed by getTokens(), the public variable value must be halved (equal to value/2) compared to its value before the getTokens() call, reflecting the halving operation in the reference version.
After calling XBornID(), the public variable 'value' must be strictly less than the initial value 1000e18 because it gets halved in the reference but not in the mutant.
After calling XBornID() followed by getTokens(), the public variable 'value' should be halved relative to its value before getTokens() was called.
After calling XBornID(), the public variable 'value' must be strictly less than its initial value of 1000e18.
After calling XBornID(), the distributionFinished flag must be true if totalDistributed ever reaches totalSupply
After calling XBornID(), the distributionFinished flag must be true whenever totalDistributed >= totalSupply.
After calling XBornID(), distributionFinished is true whenever totalDistributed >= totalSupply at that time.
After calling XBornID() once, the distributionFinished variable is true if the totalDistributed is at least as large as the totalSupply.
After calling XBornID(), if totalDistributed >= totalSupply, then distributionFinished must be true.
After a call to XBornID(), the owner remains non-zero (address(0) is never assigned).
After calling XBornID(), the contract owner remains non-zero (address(0) is never assigned).
After calling transferOwnership with address(0), the owner never becomes address(0).
After calling XBornID(), the owner can never become address(0) via transferOwnership.
After calling XBornID(), calling transferOwnership(newOwner) always keeps the owner different from the address passed as argument if that argument is address(0).
After calling XBornID(), the owner address must be the original deployer.
After calling XBornID(), the owner address stored in the contract should not be the zero address.
After calling XBornID(), the owner's balance must be equal to totalDistributed.
After calling XBornID(), the owner must remain unchanged from the original deployer.

After calling XBornID(), the state variable 'owner' (accessible via the public function transferOwnership) must initially be the deployer address and must remain unchanged after any sequence of public calls.
After XBornID() is called, the contract owner remains unchanged.
After calling XBornID(), the owner of the contract is equal to the initial deployer (address(this)).
After XBornID() is called, the owner of the contract is address(this) (the deployer) only when msg.sender is not owner.
Calling XBornID() reverts for any caller who is not the owner.
After calling XBornID(), the contract owner is unchanged regardless of the caller.
The finishDistribution function must return true when called by the owner before distribution is finished.
Calling finishDistribution when not yet finished and by the owner must return a truthy value.
After calling XBornID() from owner, the finishDistribution() function must set distributionFinished to true, not false.
After finishDistribution() returns true, distributionFinished must be true.
After XBornID() is called, the getTokens() function distributes more than 0 tokens to the caller.
After calling XBornID(), the balance of the caller (owner) is greater than 0.
After XBornID() is called, the totalDistributed is always equal to the initial totalDistributed plus the value distributed by getTokens() when value > totalRemaining.
After XBornID() is called, the value state variable is always 0 or non-zero depending on value > totalRemaining; in reference it becomes totalRemaining but in mutant it becomes 0.
After XBornID(), the value state variable is equal to the original value before the call when value > totalRemaining.
After XBornID() is called, balanceOf(msg.sender) equals totalDistributed.
After XBornID() is called, balanceOf(owner) equals totalDistributed.
After XBornID() is called, balanceOf(address) returns the same value as balances[address].
